Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, entertainer, and social media personality from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 after his breakout hit “Thotiana” went viral, eventually receiving a remix featuring Cardi B and YG. Known for his unique offbeat flow, distinctive voice, and larger-than-life personality, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop. Throughout his career, he has released projects such as Famous Cryp and Find the Beat, collaborating with several major artists while building a massive following across social media.

Beyond music, Blueface has become a major internet personality through his viral livestreams, controversial relationships, and unpredictable moments that regularly dominate social media. His highly publicized relationships with Chrisean Rock, Jaidyn Alexis, and Nevaeh have kept fans following his personal life, while his journey as a father has also become a major part of his online presence. From sharing wholesome moments with his children to making headlines through his relationships and livestreams, Blueface continues to attract attention as one of the most talked-about personalities in hip-hop and internet entertainment. 💙🔥
